001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event;
002
003import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
004import net.kyori.adventure.text.serializer.legacy.LegacyComponentSerializer;
005import org.bukkit.event.Cancellable;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
007
008/**
009 * Parent class for all cancellable events.
010 */
011public interface QSCancellable extends Cancellable {
012
013  @Nullable
014  Component getCancelReason();
015
016  default void setCancelled(final boolean cancel, @Nullable final String reason) throws IllegalStateException {
017
018    if(reason == null) {
019
020      setCancelled(cancel, (Component)null);
021      return;
022    }
023    setCancelled(cancel, LegacyComponentSerializer.legacySection().deserialize(reason));
024  }
025
026  void setCancelled(boolean cancel, @Nullable Component reason) throws IllegalStateException;
027
028  @Override
029  @Deprecated
030  default void setCancelled(final boolean cancel) throws IllegalStateException {
031
032    setCancelled(cancel, (Component)null);
033  }
034}
